The '''76th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievement in feature [[Film director|films]], [[Documentary film|documentary]], [[Television director|television]] and [[Television advertisement|commercials]] of 2023, were presented on February 10, 2024, at [[the Beverly Hilton]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Murphy |first1=J. Kim |title=Christopher Nolan Wins at Directors Guild for ''Oppenheimer'', ''The Bear'' and ''The Last of Us'' Take TV Prizes: Full DGA Winners List |url=https://variety.com/2024/film/awards/directors-guild-awards-winners-2024-list-1235901440/ |access-date=February 11, 2024 |work=Variety |date=February 10, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Lewis |first1=Hilary |last2=Coates |first2=Tyler |last3=Chuba |first3=Kirsten |title=DGA Awards: Christopher Nolan Takes Top Honor for ''Oppenheimer'' |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2024-dga-awards-winners-list-1235821741/ |access-date=February 11, 2024 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=February 10, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=76th Annual Awards Winners |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2024/240210_76thAnnualDGAAwardsWinners.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |date=February 10, 2024 |access-date=February 11, 2024}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Judd Apatow]], who previously hosted the [[70th Directors Guild of America Awards|ceremonies in 2018]], [[72nd Directors Guild of America Awards|2020]], [[74th Directors Guild of America Awards|2022]], and [[75th Directors Guild of America Awards|2023]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Clark |first1=Jason |title=Judd Apatow to Return as Host for Directors Guild Awards |url=https://www.thewrap.com/judd-apatow-hosting-dga-awards-fifth-time/ |website=TheWrap |access-date=January 19, 2024 |date=January 19, 2024}}</ref> The nominations for the television and documentary categories were announced on January 9, 2024,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Verhoeven |first1=Beatrice |title=''Succession'' Leads Directors Guild TV Nominations |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/dga-awards-tv-documentary-nominations-nominees-list-1235782461/ |access-date=January 10, 2024 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 9, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Television, Commercials and Documentary for 2023 |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2024/240109_76thAnnualDGAAwardsTelevisionNomineesAnnounced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |date=January 9, 2024 |access-date=January 10, 2024}}</ref> while the nominations for the feature film categories were announced on January 10, 2024.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pedersen |first1=Erik |title=DGA Awards Film Nominations: Gerwig, Nolan, Scorsese, Lanthimos & Payne |url=https://deadline.com/2024/01/dga-awards-film-nominations-2024-list-1235701972/ |website=Deadline |access-date=January 10, 2024 |date=January 10, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title= DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Theatrical Feature Film for 2023  |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2024/240110_76thAnnualDGAAwardsFeatureFilmNoms.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |date=January 10, 2024 |access-date=January 10, 2024}}</ref>
